answer: Because the timing is recorded against the ledge challenge, the gale audit can replay the onyx history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 215 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3452 identities would post 1871 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
